description: We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Full-time Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) to join a leading skilled nursing facility in Gainesville, FL. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a team focused on patient recovery and enhancing the quality of life for residents. You will play a vital role in implementing individualized treatment plans under the supervision of an Occupational Therapist.In this full-time position, you will work within a supportive environment, helping patients regain independence and achieve their rehabilitation goals. We offer a competitive hourly rate for this role, reflecting your valuable skills and commitment to patient care.
requirements: Associate's degree from an accredited Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) program
Current and valid COTA licensure/certification in the state of Florida
Previous experience working in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility
Ability to effectively document patient progress and communicate with the therapy team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate for Certified Occupational Therapy Assistants (COTA) is $28.00 - $37.00, based on experience.
